about.intro: I am Vishnu Sharma — a passionate Web Developer with expertise in building modern, responsive web applications.
paragraphs: With a strong foundation in frontend technologies like React, JavaScript, and modern CSS, I bring ideas to life through clean code and thoughtful design.
When I am not coding, I enjoy exploring new design trends, contributing to open-source projects, and sharing knowledge with the developer community.

projects.name: Calculator App
projects.description: A clean and easy-to-use calculator built using vanilla JavaScript with real-time operations and keyboard support. Designed for learning DOM manipulation and logic handling.

projects.name: Tic Tac Toe Game
projects.description: A classic Tic Tac Toe game built with React, allowing two players to play alternately. The game tracks moves, detects wins/draws, and offers a reset option.

projects.name: Portfolio Website
projects.description: A personal portfolio website showcasing skills, experience, and projects. It includes smooth animations, contact form, and responsive layout.

projects.name: Recipe App
projects.description: A web application where users can search and explore different recipes. It shows ingredients, cooking steps, images, and preparation time.

projects.name: Movie Search App
